data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Android SMS autofill, phone number hints, and Credential Manager.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps on Android to read one-time SMS verification codes via the SMS Retriever or User Consent APIs, request SIM-based phone number hints, and manage passwords and passkeys using Android's Credential Manager.
use_when: You need to implement automated or user-confirmed SMS OTP autofill on Android.
You need to provide phone number hints or integrate Android Credential Manager for passkeys and passwords.
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS or web platforms since this package is Android only.
You are looking for a complete cross-platform authentication UI kit.
strengths: Supports multiple modern Android authentication and autofill APIs including SMS Retriever, User Consent, and Credential Manager.
Provides a simple singleton interface with clear success, cancellation, and error handling results.
weaknesses: Requires specific Android SDK and Gradle version configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires compileSdk 35 or above, Java 11+, and specific AGP/Gradle/Kotlin configurations depending on your Flutter version.

alternatives.name: pinput
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need a customizable PIN / OTP input field widget.
